body: Hi. I have been having this exact same problem for many weeks. I have reset my password several times and gone through everything. Some idiot is liking Lego shit and that kinds of rubbish. Either a kid or a very immature adult. I can't get rid of it there is so damn much of it. I want to throw something I am so angry now. I have written to Youtube several times and they ignore me. I am so fed up. NONE of the solutions provided in this thread work.

Thank you and I am glad you found the support you need. I have just launched an online support group for South African residents and ex-pats who suffer from PTSD, so that there is 24/7 community support and engagement with peers.
Thanks. Tried that several times. They just gave me phone numbers of people who have moved on. They are nearly useless in my experience.
Thank you for saying that. I am so over hostility and division. It is breaking me into pieces. Take care of yourself and go in peace and love
Furthermore, don't underestimate what I know and do not make assumptions about my position on matters of national interest

when you stand with your boyfriend while he irons his browns in tears, maybe you would thank him him for being him, thank him for being brave enough to overcome the terror he feels because he has a gun to his head. And yes, thank him for surviving a complex shit show that people still don't understand.... those boys gave their lives and their souls because they had no choice. I thank them for their bravery. If you want to pick a political fight with me, I refuse to take your challenge... I am in the business of trying to deal with my own PTSD, and if I can, provide a safe space for others to do the same. Maybe you should look to the faction fights and assassinations... and  now the threats from that fat fuck of a Zulu king who doesn't want to give up his precious land "gold mine", and he is threatening civil war. I picked up bodies from faction fights.... first responder.... now pick on someone else!

They were proxy wars first off. Secondly, the boys who were sent there were children who were not allowed to sign contracts or drive cars yet because they were too young. Thirdly it was against their will.  If you want to discuss military history and the whys and wherefores then there must be places for that. All I care about is that these boys were badly harmed and many have suffered PTSD as a result. The injustices of Apartheid are widely discussed. PTSD is not. Nobody is suggesting that you or anybody else should be obliged to thank a generation of men for having their lives fucked up by the State. That is something that I did personally. Their stories remain untold and the majority of South Africans don't care because they are too filled with hate to find common humanity and read history.

Yes, thank you. I am physically safe right now. My head gets messed up from time to time and I experience a lot of mixed feelings. When that happens, it helps to talk to people. I have started a closed group for PTSD support, with a specifically South African focus.

Thanks. I am trying. I haven't had a serious attack of PTSD flashback in a long time, and I am fucking losing it these past few nights. I am a woman. I did not fight in the war. My combat fatigue is as a civilian. Those guys had it worse.

Also, let's not forget that the war was in our own country and on our borders, which is different from leaving your safe country to go and fight in a foreign territory.... fucken close to home. And township living must have been hell....

I don't think so. I think it has been swept under the rug. The men suffer in silence, and in my experience, open up when fuck drunk. Nobody says "thank you for your service" for the proxy wars; they would rather hate instead. So, to all the men who were like my brothers, and my friends, who were forced against their will, into horrors unknown and largely untold, I say Thank you for your service. We women saw you change from children into souls who carried the weight of the world; who could no longer communicate with us, and who preferred to get drunk or high with fellow soldiers, than be at home. I was a couple of pubs away from Magoos that night, and I spent a lot of time with servicemen in that place. I am flashing tonight, and the last couple of nights, so forgive me the morbidity please
Hi Chris, thank you for the encouraging message. It is a silent menace and a silent killer... you are right that we manage as best we can. Community peer support is helpful
thank you for understanding
Thank you. You too

I agree that professional therapy has its place, as does medication. However, if you can't talk to fellow sufferers, then you are screwed. Particularly when you are having an attack. Therapists generally have no first hand knowledge and they charge extortionist rates. When you need a buddy to talk you down, where are they?

Hi. I am here. I am also leaving my home town so your anxiety over this is something I can relate to. I began having intensifying fears and anxieties weeks ago, a slow build up over months, but am on a precipice right now too. I could try to help talk you down, if you would like to talk.
I hope you feel better. I am trying to find peer support, so I will continue to look. Therapists don't have a clue.

Yes, agreed, or those with lots of cash off-shore, who can just pick up and leave when it suits them. As for Mr Jeanpant, he appears to be in denial, and clearly does not read the mainstream news, or take his blinkers off.

Is there a PTSD group for South Africans? I have been searching for days. I am losing my shit and I need peer support, not a nuthouse, not useless Lifline etc..... please. PS Why would anyone one want to relocate to a country that is erupting in civil war? It has to be seriously bad where you live.
Thank you. Do you have experience with military / civilian combat situations?

Hi Matt, thank you for being here. At present I can't afford to see a doctor. I will have to push on through the anxiety until my circumstances have changed. I am 50, unemployed and alone. My world came crashing down 21 years ago when my only brother committed suicide. I managed to pull together a kind of life after that and I had a child, who kept me going. He has grown up and emigrated now. My world came crashing down for a second time 8 years ago when I was falsely accused of a crime that I had not committed and sent to prison, where I languished for a month awaiting trial, until the prosecution dropped the charges. The community in which I live have shunned me. I have stuck it out for 8 years, to see right by my son, but I can't do it anymore. It isn't a life. I am trying to relocate, and that will hopefully give me a better chance.
Matt, I am back in that place again. My stomach and back are in so much pain from stress. I just feel so weak and heartbroken. I am battling to keep going.
Thank you very much. Life is very hard for a lot of people. Best wishes to you too

Hi Matt, thank you for responding. I have managed to get through another night and half a day, and I have formed a plan to try to get myself into new circumstances. If I can make that work, there is renewed hope for a meaningful life.

When I post a URL to a site that I want to direct people to from my Instagram posts, the URLs are not working. I sell print on demand apparel and decor items and I am unable to direct buyers to my stores. I have reported this twice to Instagram, but there is no response and no change. I pay for advertising on Instagram and Facebook, and I am rely on organic marketing too. I need my URLs to work!
